causal_diagnosis.budget_failure: Actual submitted weights fail the budget, while exact sent feedback correctly reports own D0 sum and residual. No calculator arithmetic bug found in these completed cases.
causal_diagnosis.budget_limits: This does not identify why the model failed, or establish that proposed wording will fix it. Invalid-vector risk and active-weight feedback are null by existing design; absence of those fields is not a wrong sum.
causal_diagnosis.source_fields: Original F0 absence condition is followed by standalone null-field imperatives. A clearer explicit branch is warranted, but the single E failure cannot prove causation. Undefined source_label field meaning plausibly contributes to issuer/title substitutions across visible-source drafts and finals.
causal_diagnosis.citations: E D0 contains unknown ID correlation; completed E/L finals have no unknown IDs. Valid IDs coexist with incorrect numerical claims and contradictory attribution.

exact_text_amendments.new: The feedback's raw_budget_residual equals sum(D0 weights)-1. A budget correction requires the net change across all eleven weights to offset that residual; verify the sum of the eleven numbers actually submitted as F0 before claiming the budget is satisfied.

not_recommended: Do not normalize, clip, replace invalid vectors, retry until success, add hidden source truth or give per-sector target weights.
Do not add output-specific citation/label corrections to F0; that would introduce semantic coaching beyond the existing arithmetic intervention.

Do not change source documents, numeric market data, common context, response schema, source timing, number of turns, model, generation settings or completed historical evidence in this prompt amendment.
Do not change tables to a different input representation merely because some claims have wrong units; that is a separate intervention with broader confounds.
Do not treat schema/transport validity, arithmetic validity and semantic fidelity as interchangeable or require semantically successful output to enter main.
confounds_and_disclosure: The new prompt is informed by old pilot outcomes; preserve and label those outcomes as development, freeze a new version before generation and do not pool versions as identical replications.
Wording, instruction length and exposure change. Any improvement cannot be attributed solely to correcting an ambiguous branch or to evidence timing.
E/L compare history, timing and exposure together; C lacks source content. None isolates a pure psychological mechanism or pure semantic information effect.
One run per five cells does not establish reproducibility, significance, population causality or equivalence. Eleven sector rows are not eleven independent experimental units.
An arithmetic-valid vector may still have unsupported reasoning. An arithmetic-invalid vector may preserve source meaning but is ineligible for valid-portfolio distance.

main_readiness_interpretation.allowed_basis: Correct inputs, preserved E/L/C boundaries, frozen review/code/runtime, faithful request/output capture, declared missingness and no retries.
main_readiness_interpretation.not_required: Zero arithmetic errors, perfect citations, a desired institutional contrast or a favored semantic verdict.
main_readiness_interpretation.if_no_valid_pairs: Primary allocation contrast remains unobserved; report source-reading and feasibility/failure diagnostics and do not claim the allocation question was answered.
main_readiness_interpretation.if_runtime_changed: Do not call it an exact historical replication. Either restore pinned environment or explicitly version/freeze and qualify a new runtime before generation.
